suggestion.to: Our Compact CMOS Camera Demonstrator (C3D) won one of only three science payload slots on UKube-1, the UK Space Agency’s first CubeSat. Launched in July 2014, its three cameras made the first in-orbit demonstration of a European 0.18-micron CMOS imaging technology. Radiation testing showed the sensor degrading much like a CCD, along with effects unique to CMOS such as single-event upsets, and the data has since informed the design of more radiation-tolerant space CMOS sensors.
